jobs.description: Structural Engineer (all genders) - Material Testing & Structural ValidationHelp Accelerate Industrial DecarbonizationJoin exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.As our Structural Engineer – Material Testing & Structural Validation, you'll play a key role in developing the lightweight structural systems that make GlassPoint's technology reliable, safe, and scalable.Working closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams, you'll combine advanced engineering analysis with hands-on testing to validate innovative designs and ensure they perform under real-world conditions. From small-scale material characterization to full-scale component testing, your work will directly influence the next generation of technology. Your ImpactThe structures you validate will become part of some of the world's largest industrial solar thermal plants, helping heavy industry reduce emissions while improving energy security.You'll combine engineering theory with practical experimentation, transforming test results into optimized designs and helping GlassPoint continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of its technology.What You'll DoDesign & Improve Structural Systems- Analyze and optimize lightweight structural systems, components, and structural connections.- Evaluate the behavior of steel, aluminum, composite materials, and ETFE film systems.- Support the development of innovative structural concepts for industrial solar thermal applications.- Transform engineering insights into scalable, manufacturable design improvements.Lead Material & Component Testing- Plan, build, execute, and evaluate material and component tests.- Design and instrument full-scale structural testing.- Conduct small-specimen material testing to characterize material behavior.- Analyze test results and translate findings into engineering recommendations.Develop & Validate Engineering Models- Develop, calibrate, and improve nonlinear finite element (FEA) models.- Predict structural behavior using numerical simulations.- Validate simulation results through physical testing.- Continuously refine engineering models to improve design accuracy.Collaborate Across Engineering- Work closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams.- Support design decisions through data-driven engineering.- Contribute to solving complex structural challenges across international projects.- Share technical expertise and help drive continuous innovation.Who You AreYou're someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and turning analysis into practical solutions.You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy moving between simulations, laboratory testing, and real-world engineering. You're curious, collaborative, and motivated by seeing your work become part of technologies that make a global impact.Ideally, you'll bring:- A degree in Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (ideally with a background in construction, civil engineering, or automotive engineering).- Several years of experience in structural, material, or component testing.- Experience working with nonlinear material behavior and structural analysis.- Strong experience with numerical modelling and nonlinear FEA.- Hands-on experience planning and executing engineering tests.- Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, and measurement systems.- A structured, analytical, and independent working style.- Confidence working in an international engineering environment.- Excellent English communication skills; German is an advantage.- Experience with foundation systems for solar structures, soil testing, rammed piles, ground screws, or percussion drilling is a plus.What You'll Find at GlassPoint- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization. We value inclusion and foster a culture of belonging, welcoming team members of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation. GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security.  We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Materialwissenschaft, Konstruktion, Versuchsdurchführung und -auswertung

jobs.description: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Experimental Cancer NeuroscienceFull- or part-time | temporary (36 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für ChirurgieWe are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our internationally active research group at the interface of cancer biology, neuroscience and tumor immunology.Our group investigates how the nervous system shapes tumor initiation, progression, invasion, metastasis and cancer-associated symptoms, with a particular focus on pancreatic cancer and cancer neuroscience. We combine mechanistic cancer biology with neuroscience, immunology, advanced in vivo models, spatial and single-cell technologies, functional imaging and translational human studies.Our ambition is clear: to define and lead emerging concepts in cancer neuroscience rather than merely follow them.The laboratory operates in a highly competitive and well-funded environment with support from, among others, the European Research Council (ERC), Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Deutsche Krebshilfe and Else Kröner-Fresenius-Stiftung, and is embedded in a strong national and international network in cancer neuroscience.Your responsibilities:The successful candidate will take a central scientific role in our experimental program and will contribute to the conception, execution and development of ambitious projects addressing neural–tumor–immune interactions.Depending on expertise, projects may include:- mechanistic studies of neuron–cancer and neuro–immune interactions- functional characterization of neural signaling pathways in cancer- genetically engineered and orthotopic in vivo tumor models- manipulation of neuronal, immune and tumor-cell populations- advanced imaging and molecular phenotyping- integration of molecular, cellular and spatial data with functional experiments- development of new experimental concepts and therapeutic strategies in cancer neuroscienceA particularly important aspect of the position is the strategic management and further development of our animal experimentation platform.This may include:- preparation and coordination of animal study applications and amendments- planning and supervision of complex in vivo experiments- establishment and optimization of experimental mouse models- management of genetically modified mouse colonies- breeding strategy, genotyping and colony planning- coordination with animal facilities, authorities and collaborating laboratories- implementation of high standards in experimental design, documentation and animal welfareYour profile:We are looking for a scientist with a strong experimental background in at least one – preferably several – of the following fields: Cancer Biology | Tumor Immunology | Neuroscience | Neuroimmunology | Molecular BiologyYou should have:- a PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant life-science discipline- substantial hands-on experience in experimental biomedical research as well as experience with in vivo models, ideally tumor models and/or neuroscience models- strong expertise in molecular and cellular biology and the ability to independently design, troubleshoot and drive complex experiments- excellent scientific communication skills in English- a highly collaborative but intellectually independent working styleParticularly desirable is extensive experience with:- animal experimentation and experimental planning and preparation or management of animal experimentation applications- genetically engineered mouse models as well as mouse breeding and colony management- tumor models and neuroscience or neuroimmunology techniquesWe offer you:- This is not intended to be a purely technical postdoctoral position.- We offer the opportunity to become a scientifically visible and intellectually independent member of a rapidly developing research program, with substantial room to shape projects and develop an individual research profile. - Our goal is to attract scientists who want to build a field, not simply complete a project.- You will work in an internationally competitive cancer neuroscience environment; ERC-, DFG-, Deutsche Krebshilfe- and foundation-funded research programs; highly interdisciplinary collaborations spanning cancer biology, neuroscience, immunology, surgery, pathology, spatial biology and computational biology- We offe you projects with strong potential for high-impact publications and a translational environment with direct access to human cancer material and clinically relevant questions as well as an international network of leading scientists in the emerging field of Cancer Neuroscience- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers- Working in the heart of Munich at Max-Weber-Platz with very good accessibility by public transport such as the subway, S-Bahn or tram We look forward to meeting you!Contact: Sarah position in question is equal, severely disabled applicants shall be given preference. jobs.description: Director Global Quality (m/f/x)Wieland-Werke AG I Ulm I Business Unit Thermal Solutions I Ident. Code 2026-0154 I immediatelyUnleash potential.Copper connects the world - in technologies, such as eMobility, energy and data transfer, refrigeration and air conditioning technology, digitalization and the Internet of Things. Surprise us with your fresh thinking, new impulses and shape the world of tomorrow. Discover numerous opportunities to unleash your potential.Wieland stands for diversity and equal opportunities - for this reason, we welcome individual applications regardless of age, gender, nationality, religion, ethnic and social background.Director Global Quality (m/f/x) Your FutureIn this newly created key leadership role, you will shape the development of a globally aligned quality organization and support sustainable international growth. Together with our manufacturing sites around the world, you will establish global quality standards, drive the digital transformation of our quality organization and ensure consistently high product quality across our international operations.- Strategy: As Director Global Quality (m/f/d), you will define and drive the global quality strategy for our Thermal Solutions Business Unit. You will establish a unified quality framework across our international manufacturing sites and align them around shared quality objectives.- Transformation: You will play a key role in shaping the future of our global quality organization. By harmonizing quality systems, processes and standards, you will build a scalable organization that supports international growth and the successful integration of newly acquired sites.- Digitalization: You will drive the digital transformation of our quality management processes by implementing modern Quality Management Systems (QMS) and data-driven performance management tools, increasing transparency, efficiency and operational excellence across all locations.- Operational Excellence: You will manage global quality KPIs, lead cross-functional continuous improvement initiatives and foster a culture of operational excellence across the entire organization, ensuring sustainable performance improvements.- Global Collaboration: Working closely with our manufacturing sites as well as cross-functional teams in Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain and other business functions, you will establish globally aligned quality standards and successfully integrate new sites into our global quality framework.- Customer Focus: Together with our global teams, you will ensure outstanding quality throughout the entire product lifecycle. By enabling successful new product introductions, reducing scrap rates and enhancing customer satisfaction, you will create measurable value for our customers worldwide.Your Potential- Education: You hold a Master's degree in Quality Management, Operations, Engineering or a comparable field.- Leadership: You bring extensive leadership experience in global quality management within an international manufacturing environment and are experienced in operating within a matrix organization.- Transformation Expertise: You have successfully led international transformation and standardization initiatives and have a proven track record of developing global quality organizations.- Technical Expertise: You possess in-depth knowledge of modern Quality Management Systems and Lean Management, complemented by strong analytical, strategic and systemic thinking.- Personality: You are an empathetic and inspiring leader with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of bringing people together and driving sustainable change across international organizations.- Language: You communicate fluently in German and English. Italian or French language skills are considered an advantage.- Mobility: You enjoy working in an international environment and are willing to travel globally to collaborate closely with our manufacturing sites and stakeholders worldwide.Your Benefits- A Great Place to Work: Join a motivated team where collaboration, mutual respect and a positive working atmosphere are part of our everyday culture.- Comprehensive Benefits: Benefit from an attractive package including a company pension scheme, childcare support, Christmas gifts for employees' children, employee appreciation gifts, subsidized meals in our company restaurant with healthy food options, and a wide range of employee discounts.- Health & Well-being: Your health matters to us. We support your well-being through a variety of initiatives, including Wellpass, our in-house health program ("Vitalwerkstatt") and company sports groups.- Health Services: We care about your physical and mental well-being. Our on-site occupational physicians and medical team are available whenever you need support. You also benefit from our orthopedic express service and free, confidential employee assistance program, offering professional advice and support for both work-related and personal matters – including your immediate family members.Interested?I am happy to answer your questions by email: recruiting@wieland.comMs Marina TikvicApplypowered by d.vinci

jobs.occupation: Design Engineer for costumized Equipment, Fixture and Tool Construction (all genders) - Aerospace (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description: html Design Engineer for costumized Equipment, Fixture and Tool Construction (all genders) - AerospaceTaufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee About usBlackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.Design Engineer for costumized Equipment, Fixture and Tool Construction (all genders) - AerospaceTaufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIESYour mission: Design the tools that build the future. At the cutting edge of aerospace manufacturing, you’ll develop high-precision equipment and intelligent solutions for our production of advanced components – from winding tools for composites to CNC-ready fixtures.- Develop & design Tools & fixtures: Design production equipment regarding costum machine design/ Special machines such as winding tools for fibre-reinforced plastics and metallic components.- Create technical drawings: Generate standard-compliant individual part and assembly drawings – with clean geometric dimensioning and tolerancing.- Choose materials with intent: Select materials based on performance, efficiency and manufacturability – always with a mindset for lean and robust design.- Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with development and manufacturing teams to turn great ideas into production-ready tools.- Own your designs: Ensure your concepts are not only functional and ergonomic, but also cost-effective and easy to implement on the shopfloor.YOUR PROFILE- A solid foundation: Completed degree or training as a design engineer, technical product designer, state-certified technician in mechanical engineering or a related degree- On the job experience: You have several years hands-on experience in designing special-purpose machinery, fixtures and toolings and you know what matters in day-to-day industrial operations.- Drawing and CAD confidence: Skilled in creating technical drawings and using modern CAD tools. Experience with SolidWorks is a plus.- Manufacturing mindset: Familiar with production processes such as CNC machining (milling, turning), and design for manufacturability is second nature.- Curiosity & drive: You love solving problems, exploring new technologies and designing elegant, practical solutions.- Strong communication: Fluent in English and German, both in the workshop and with cross-functional teams.- Composites experience (nice to have): Familiarity with fibre-reinforced plastics and their processing methods gives you an edge.WHAT WE OFFER- Creative freedom & responsibility: Autonomy, scope for decision-making and short implementation paths.- Flexible working hours & remote option: You can work remotely by arrangement.- Culinary variety: Lunch together with fresh, varied dishes every day.- Attractive additional benefits: Choose between Deutschlandticket, EGYM-Wellpass or a monthly top-up payment card (Givve Card).- Knowledge exchange at the highest level: Work with experienced engineers and experts from the aerospace industry.- Dynamic environment: Exciting projects, development opportunities and a start-up atmosphere with agile, cross-functional collaboration.- Community & team spirit: Monthly blackout events for socialising, networking and exchange.- Unique working atmosphere: Enjoy the end of the working day on our large roof terrace with a view of the Alps!#LI-OnsitePlease refer to reference number YF-49787 for your application.Apply for this jobHomeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
